congestion_status_logic: congested when predicted network average speed is below the existing sensor speed threshold; otherwise not_congested

feature_definitions.speed_lag_1: value exactly 5 minutes before prediction time
feature_definitions.speed_lag_2: value exactly 10 minutes before prediction time
feature_definitions.speed_lag_3: value exactly 15 minutes before prediction time
feature_definitions.speed_lag_6: value exactly 30 minutes before prediction time
feature_definitions.speed_lag_12: value exactly 60 minutes before prediction time
feature_definitions.congestion_percentage_lag_1: value exactly 5 minutes before prediction time
feature_definitions.congestion_percentage_lag_2: value exactly 10 minutes before prediction time
feature_definitions.congestion_percentage_lag_3: value exactly 15 minutes before prediction time
feature_definitions.congestion_percentage_lag_6: value exactly 30 minutes before prediction time
feature_definitions.congestion_percentage_lag_12: value exactly 60 minutes before prediction time
feature_definitions.speed_past_15m_mean: mean over the preceding 3 valid five-minute grid slots, ending before prediction time
feature_definitions.speed_past_15m_std: std over the preceding 3 valid five-minute grid slots, ending before prediction time
feature_definitions.speed_past_30m_mean: mean over the preceding 6 valid five-minute grid slots, ending before prediction time
feature_definitions.speed_past_30m_std: std over the preceding 6 valid five-minute grid slots, ending before prediction time
feature_definitions.speed_past_60m_mean: mean over the preceding 12 valid five-minute grid slots, ending before prediction time
feature_definitions.speed_past_60m_std: std over the preceding 12 valid five-minute grid slots, ending before prediction time
feature_definitions.congestion_percentage_past_15m_mean: mean over the preceding 3 valid five-minute grid slots, ending before prediction time
feature_definitions.congestion_percentage_past_15m_std: std over the preceding 3 valid five-minute grid slots, ending before prediction time
feature_definitions.congestion_percentage_past_30m_mean: mean over the preceding 6 valid five-minute grid slots, ending before prediction time
feature_definitions.congestion_percentage_past_30m_std: std over the preceding 6 valid five-minute grid slots, ending before prediction time
feature_definitions.congestion_percentage_past_60m_mean: mean over the preceding 12 valid five-minute grid slots, ending before prediction time
feature_definitions.congestion_percentage_past_60m_std: std over the preceding 12 valid five-minute grid slots, ending before prediction time
feature_definitions.time_of_day_sin: sine of UTC minute-of-day angle at prediction time
feature_definitions.time_of_day_cos: cosine of UTC minute-of-day angle at prediction time
feature_definitions.day_of_week_sin: sine of UTC weekday angle at prediction time
feature_definitions.day_of_week_cos: cosine of UTC weekday angle at prediction time

persistence.rule: use the metric observed at the forecast origin

data_quality.threshold_definition: a valid sensor speed strictly below threshold is congested
data_quality.zero_policy: zero is valid, included in averages/counts, and congested below threshold
data_quality.null_policy: null, non-numeric, infinite, and negative speeds are excluded
